profile.name: Stephanie Reinagel
profile.body_type: high-waist rectangle / full bust (photo 8/31/26); belt and tuck; skip extra shoulder volume
profile.lifestyle: Homestead mom of 5, NW Arkansas — farm stand, outdoors, church, busy weekdays solo parenting

items.name: Mid-wash wide-leg jeans
items.description: High-rise mid-wash wide/straight jeans. Photographed in a mirror selfie with an olive ribbed tank (tank is a separate layering piece, not this entry).
items.rating_reason: Strong pear staple — wide legs streamline hips. Cool mid-wash is only fair Soft Autumn, but fills a critical winter bottom gap alongside olive pants. Versatile homestead denim.

items.name: Light-wash MAMA denim jacket
items.description: Oversized light-wash denim jacket with chest flap pockets and faded white MAMA lettering on the back.
items.rating_reason: Practical mom layer; light wash + graphic only fair Soft Autumn.

items.name: Navy-and-white stripe midi dress
items.description: Long-sleeve jersey midi with fine navy/white horizontal stripes, crew neck, chest pocket, gathered waist.
items.rating_reason: Waist + skirt pear-friendly; high-contrast cool stripes Soft Autumn fair.

items.name: Olive jersey t-shirt dress
items.description: Short-sleeve crew-neck olive jersey dress with relaxed straight cut.
items.rating_reason: Muted olive Soft Autumn staple; belt for pear waist.

items.name: Dusty rose utility midi dress
items.description: Sleeveless dusty-rose button-front midi with V-neck, pockets, and gathered waist.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn dusty rose + waist + pockets = hero.

items.name: Medium-wash denim overalls
items.description: Classic bib overalls in medium blue denim with adjustable straps and straight legs.
items.rating_reason: Homestead workwear hero; layer Soft Autumn knits under.

items.name: Navy faux-wrap maxi dress
items.description: Deep navy knit maxi with faux-wrap V bodice, short sleeves, gathered waist.
items.rating_reason: Wrap silhouette excellent for pear; navy workable with warm accessories.

items.name: Navy wildflower wrap dress
items.description: Long-sleeve navy wrap with small wildflower print and self-tie waist.
items.rating_reason: Wrap + waist pear gold; muted florals work Soft Autumn.

items.name: Metallic silver crinkle V-top
items.description: Short-sleeve deep V metallic silver/gray crinkle texture top.
items.rating_reason: Cool metallic clashes Soft Autumn; occasion-only.

items.name: Navy ditsy floral cinched blouse
items.description: Sheer short-sleeve navy V-neck with ditsy florals and cinched waist.
items.rating_reason: Feminine waist-defining; sheer less homestead-practical.

items.name: Navy V-neck short-sleeve top
items.description: Relaxed short-sleeve jersey top with a deep V-neck and straight body. Soft knit with casual wrinkling from wear.
items.rating_reason: Practical everyday staple and V draws the eye up for pear; cool saturated navy is only fair for Soft Autumn, and the cut lacks waist definition.

items.name: Navy bell-sleeve V-neck top
items.description: Deep navy knit top with a moderate V-neck and three-quarter sleeves ending in flared bell/ruffle cuffs. Straight relaxed hem.
items.rating_reason: Feminine sleeve detail and V-neck help balance pear proportions; navy is workable but cool for Soft Autumn and silhouette is still boxy at the waist.

items.name: Navy-and-white stripe long-sleeve tee
items.description: Classic crew-neck long-sleeve tee with thin horizontal navy stripes on a bright white ground. Soft jersey, straight relaxed fit.
items.rating_reason: Horizontal stripes can add upper-body width (helpful for pear) and it's wash-and-wear, but high-contrast cool navy/white clashes with Soft Autumn.

items.name: Olive waffle-knit colorblock top
items.description: Long-sleeve waffle-knit top in muted olive with darker forest-green crew neck and solid lower sleeves. Relaxed, slightly boxy hem.
items.rating_reason: Excellent Soft Autumn earthy greens and homestead-practical texture that hides dirt; tuck or half-tuck for pear waist definition.

items.name: Heather gray Mama Bear sweatshirt
items.description: Light heather-gray crewneck sweatshirt with a large distressed charcoal bear graphic and 'MAMA BEAR' text. Drop-shoulder relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem.
items.rating_reason: Fun sentimental cozy piece for homestead days, but cool gray plus dark graphic reads off Soft Autumn and the boxy cut skips the waist.

items.name: Ivory textured knit sweater
items.description: Warm off-white crewneck sweater with waffle/honeycomb body, pointelle openwork at the shoulders, and ribbed neck, cuffs, and hem. Relaxed straight cut.
items.rating_reason: Soft cream is a Soft Autumn hero neutral with cozy texture; layer or belt/tuck for pear. Slightly precious for muddy chores but strong for cooler days.

items.name: Mustard crewneck sweatshirt
items.description: Solid muted ochre/mustard crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem. Medium-weight fleece/jersey in a relaxed boxy fit.
items.rating_reason: Textbook Soft Autumn warm muted yellow and a washable homestead staple; pair with darker bottoms and a belt/tuck to define the pear waist.

items.name: Olive straight-leg pants
items.description: Muted moss/olive woven pants with a button waistband and relaxed straight legs. Matte twill-like fabric suited to everyday wear.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn hallmark color, dirt-hiding, and straight legs streamline pear hips—core capsule bottom.

items.name: Black Arizona graphic tee
items.description: Jet-black short-sleeve crew tee with a high-contrast white Arizona outline graphic and 'Home IS WHERE THE SAGUARO IS' text. Soft jersey, slightly fitted cut.
items.rating_reason: Harsh black/white contrast fights Soft Autumn; keep only for sentimental/casual use if needed, not a capsule builder.

items.name: Beige leopard-print tank
items.description: Sleeveless scoop-neck tank with wide straps and an all-over small-scale leopard/cheetah print on a muted beige base. Lightweight, loose drape.
items.rating_reason: Warm earthy animal print can work Soft Autumn as a layering accent; straight tank won't define pear waist—best under open layers.

items.name: Heather blue muscle tank
items.description: Muted heathered medium-blue sleeveless muscle tank with wide armholes, ribbed crew neck, and a faint dark chest graphic. Soft jersey, boxy cut.
items.rating_reason: Practical chore/layer piece, but cool blue and boxy no-waist shape are weak for Soft Autumn and pear.

items.name: Black sleeveless button blouse
items.description: Solid black sleeveless woven button-front top with a V-neck, pale buttons, and light gathering under the bust for a soft empire flare.
items.rating_reason: V and under-bust gather help pear a bit and black hides stains, but true black is harsh on Soft Autumn and wrinkles show.

items.name: Light heather gray tank
items.description: Basic light heather-gray scoop-neck tank with wide straps and a straight, non-shaped body. Thin jersey knit.
items.rating_reason: Useful layering basic for homestead heat, but cool gray and no waist shape make it filler rather than flattering Soft Autumn/pear.

items.name: Navy lace-panel sleeveless top
items.description: Deep muted navy/charcoal sleeveless top with vertical floral lace panels and an embroidered lace V-yoke at a high round neck. Flowy, slightly A-line drape.
items.rating_reason: Feminine upward detail helps pear balance, but sheer lace is less homestead-practical and dark cool tone is only fair Soft Autumn; little waist definition.

items.name: Black long-sleeve satin tunic
items.description: Solid jet-black long-sleeve tunic (or short mini-dress length) with a wide shallow V-neck and drapey fabric with a slight sheen. Straight relaxed silhouette.
items.rating_reason: Harsh black and shiny fabric fight Soft Autumn; straight cut skips pear waist and satin is less chore-friendly.

items.name: Charcoal button-front waist dress
items.description: Sleeveless dark charcoal/black button-front dress with deep V-neck, textured crinkle fabric, and a defined waist seam with drawstring/elastic. Slightly flared skirt.
items.rating_reason: Strong pear silhouette (waist + A-line) and nursing-friendly buttons, but cool near-black is only fair Soft Autumn—better if it reads soft charcoal in person.

items.name: Rust quilted crewneck pullover
items.description: Muted warm rust/terracotta crewneck pullover with an all-over quilted chevron/V texture. Thick cozy knit, relaxed boxy fit.
items.rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn earthy rust, cozy and practical for NW Arkansas cool weather; belt or tuck to define pear waist.

items.name: Black quilted crewneck pullover
items.description: Solid black long-sleeve quilted pullover with a fine diamond-grid texture, ribbed crew neck and cuffs, and a slightly relaxed fit.
items.rating_reason: Same cozy practical construction as the rust twin, but solid black is harsh Soft Autumn—filler warmth piece only.

items.name: Navy peach floral wrap maxi
items.description: Navy jersey wrap maxi with large peach/cream/coral florals and sage leaves, surplice V-neck, short sleeves, elastic waist. Same dress photographed twice (also as IMG_0115).
items.rating_reason: Wrap + waist + A-line maxi is excellent for pear and nursing; muted warm florals on navy work Soft Autumn. Duplicate photo retired.
items.notes: Duplicate of IMG_0115 (same garment, second photo).

items.name: Unidentifiable (motion blur)
items.description: Extremely motion-blurred accidental shot with only diagonal streaks of tan/beige/brown; no garment can be identified.
items.rating_reason: Photo is unusable for wardrobe cataloguing—retake needed if this was meant to document a piece.

items.name: Navy peach floral wrap maxi (duplicate photo)
items.description: Same dress as IMG_0112 — second photo only. Do not count as a separate piece.
items.rating_reason: Duplicate entry of IMG_0112 (navy peach floral wrap maxi).
items.notes: Duplicate of IMG_0112. Use IMG_0112 in capsules/menus.

items.name: Olive short-sleeve midi dress
items.description: Muted dark olive knit midi with short sleeves, waist seam with light gathering, and a subtle A-line skirt to mid-calf. Soft jersey, practical everyday cut.
items.rating_reason: Excellent Soft Autumn olive, waist definition + skimming A-line for pear, washable one-and-done for busy mom days—capsule hero.

items.name: Black spaghetti-strap jumpsuit
items.description: Solid black sleeveless jumpsuit with thin spaghetti straps, V-neck, and a very relaxed oversized wide-leg silhouette. Lightweight woven fabric with soft wrinkles.
items.rating_reason: Harsh black plus shapeless cut works against Soft Autumn and pear waist goals; only keep if belted and layered often.

items.name: Olive tiered drawstring dress
items.description: Muted olive/sage short-sleeve tiered dress with V-neck, lettuce-edge ruffles, and an adjustable drawstring waist with ties. Soft flowy knit, midi/maxi length.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn olive, adjustable waist for postpartum/pear, feminine tiers that skim hips—practical washable hero.

items.name: Dusty blue smocked tiered dress
items.description: Muted dusty blue woven cotton-like dress with deep V, short flutter sleeves, wide smocked elastic waist, and ruffled tiered skirt. Casual feminine silhouette.
items.rating_reason: Excellent pear waist + tiered skirt shape and homestead-practical cotton, but dusty cool blue is only fair Soft Autumn versus warmer neutrals.

items.name: Blue-grey pinstripe wide pants
items.description: Muted dusty blue-grey trousers with thin vertical white pinstripes, thick cream elastic waistband, and a relaxed wide/straight leg in lightweight woven fabric.
items.rating_reason: Vertical stripes and wide legs help elongate/balance pear; elastic waist is postpartum-friendly, but cool blue-grey is middling Soft Autumn.

items.name: Navy peach floral knit dress
items.description: Short-sleeve scoop-neck knit dress with a muted navy ground and dense cream, peach, and sage florals. Stretch jersey, likely a fitted/bodycon silhouette.
items.rating_reason: Muted florals read Soft Autumn, but navy is cool and the clingy knit will map hips without a waist. Fine as a throw-on if it does not cling; otherwise skip.

items.name: Charcoal puff-sleeve smocked dress
items.description: Dark charcoal midi with a deep V/surplice bodice, voluminous elastic-cuff puff sleeves, a wide smocked waist, and a gathered skirt. Matte cotton or linen-blend look.
items.rating_reason: Near-perfect pear architecture (shoulder volume, V-neck, defined waist), but charcoal/black is too cool and heavy for Soft Autumn. Keep if the fabric is warm-grey; otherwise wear with warm jewelry and a rust cardigan.

items.name: Terracotta ditsy tank dress
items.description: Sleeveless jersey tank dress in muted rust with a tiny white ditsy print, deep scoop neck, and wide straps. Visible hole near the lower front.
items.rating_reason: Color is a Soft Autumn hero and wide straps help balance hips, but jersey can cling and the hole makes it chore-only unless repaired. Not capsule-worthy as-is.

items.name: Sage off-shoulder ruffle dress
items.description: Muted sage jersey midi with an elastic off-shoulder neckline and a large ruffle/flounce that reads as flutter sleeves, then a simple straight skirt.
items.rating_reason: Sage is textbook Soft Autumn and the ruffle adds upper-body volume for a pear. Knit is easy mom fabric; off-shoulder is less barn-practical but great for church, photos, and summer evenings.

items.name: Terracotta tiered long-sleeve dress
items.description: Solid burnt-orange/terracotta long-sleeve knit dress with a modest crew neck, smocked cuffs, and a loose tiered skirt from mid-torso down.
items.rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn color and homestead-practical (coverage, movement, one-and-done). No waist cinch so it is not the most pear-defining; a belt or cardigan would lift it to staple-plus.

items.name: Burgundy velvet wrap dress
items.description: Deep burgundy velvet wrap with a V-neck, short puffed sleeves, self-tie waist, and midi/maxi length. Slight sheen.
items.rating_reason: Wrap + V-neck is excellent for a pear, but this burgundy is cool and saturated versus muted Soft Autumn, and velvet is church/date not chickens. Keep as an occasion piece, not a daily staple.

items.name: Heather grey jersey sheath dress
items.description: Cool heathered-grey long-sleeve jersey dress with a simple crew neck and a straight, body-skimming sheath cut.
items.rating_reason: Cool grey fights Soft Autumn and a clingy sheath highlights hips with no waist. Comfortable, but it will not earn its hanger in this capsule.

items.name: Black bodice medallion maxi
items.description: Sleeveless maxi with a solid black tank bodice, waist tie, and a full skirt in a muted dusty-rose, cream, and tan medallion/boho floral on a dark ground.
items.rating_reason: Skirt palette is Soft Autumn and the tie defines the waist over hips. Black bodice is harsh; still a useful one-and-done if layered with a camel cardigan at the face.

items.name: Black tie-waist tank maxi
items.description: Solid black jersey tank maxi with wide straps, modest scoop neck, and a self-tie waist that gathers the fabric. Full length.
items.rating_reason: Tie waist is pear-friendly and jersey is easy, but true black is too stark for Soft Autumn and will show dust, flour, and animal hair on a homestead.

items.name: Olive scoop-neck tank
items.description: Sleeveless tank in muted moss/olive with wide straps and a deep scoop neck. Soft solid jersey.
items.rating_reason: Olive is a Soft Autumn staple and a wide-strap scoop draws the eye up. Tucked into a high-waist skirt or jeans it is a daily homestead layer.

items.name: Dusty sage heather tank
items.description: Light dusty sage/mint heather tank with wide straps, simple round neck, and a straight relaxed hem.
items.rating_reason: Muted green mostly works though it leans a touch cool. Basic pear layer—needs a tuck or open cardigan. Keep as a summer undershirt.

items.name: Tan ditsy floral maxi skirt
items.description: Lightweight midi/maxi skirt with a ruffled elastic waist and a small-scale ditsy floral on muted tan, flecked with dusty blue, burgundy, and olive.
items.rating_reason: Palette is Soft Autumn textbook, elastic waist plus flowy A-line is ideal pear, print hides stains, and it moves with kids and farm days. Hero capsule piece.

items.name: Dusty rose Mama Bear tee
items.description: Heathered muted rose crewneck tee with a white 'Mama Bear' script, bear silhouette, and heart graphic. Soft jersey, relaxed fit.
items.rating_reason: Dusty rose is a strong Soft Autumn mom color; straight tee needs a front tuck or knot for a pear waist. Playful and washable—keep one, not a pile of graphics.

items.name: Tomato-red Kampout 2023 tee
items.description: Bright warm tomato-red crewneck tee with a rectangular 'Best Time Ever / KAMPOUT 2023 / GRACE POINT CHURCH' graphic in white and pale blue-grey.
items.rating_reason: Saturated true red is too bright for muted Soft Autumn and the boxy graphic tee does nothing for a pear waist. Keep as a memory/PJs piece, not in the capsule.

items.name: Heather navy V-neck tee
items.description: Muted dusty heather navy V-neck short-sleeve tee with marled flecks and a simple relaxed cut.
items.rating_reason: Heathered navy is more wearable than jet black for Soft Autumn, and a V-neck helps a pear. Not a color hero, but a solid layering tee if tucked.

items.name: Heather grey MAMA raglan
items.description: Cool medium heather-grey long-sleeve raglan with a ribbed crew neck and vertical white 'MAMA' print.
items.rating_reason: Cool grey and a straight raglan are meh for Soft Autumn and pear. Sentimental and cozy for chores; not a wardrobe building block.

items.name: Black crewneck sweatshirt
items.description: Solid black crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem, boxy relaxed fit. Visible lint and pilling.
items.rating_reason: Black plus pilling plus homestead lint is a losing combo, and Soft Autumn looks better in oatmeal or cocoa. Boxy volume can balance hips, but this specific piece is a replace-not-keep.

items.name: Grey All of Life for Jesus tee
items.description: Muted heather medium-grey crewneck tee with a dark 'ALL of LIFE for JESUS' serif/block graphic.
items.rating_reason: Faith message fits the home, but cool grey is only a fair Soft Autumn neutral and the straight tee needs a tuck. Keep if worn often; do not build the capsule around it.

items.name: Black tiered high-low tank
items.description: Solid black sleeveless round-neck tank with a double-layered, slightly high-low tiered hem.
items.rating_reason: Black is harsh on Soft Autumn, and a flared/tiered hem adds volume right at the hips—the opposite of pear strategy. Easy pass.

items.name: Heather grey muscle tank
items.description: Basic athletic heather-grey tank with a high round neck, wide straps, moderately deep armholes, and a straight hip-length hang.
items.rating_reason: Useful for workouts or under a flannel, but cool grey and a shapeless muscle cut are not capsule-priority for Soft Autumn or pear.

items.name: Charcoal heather tank
items.description: Dark charcoal heather sleeveless tank with a scoop neck and a straight, untailored casual fit.
items.rating_reason: Too close to black for Soft Autumn and no waist. Keep only as a cheap layer under a warm cardigan; oatmeal tanks in this batch replace it.

items.name: Oatmeal Awaken graphic sweatshirt
items.description: Muted heathered oatmeal crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed trim and a large circular black 'Awaken / coffee, matcha and chai' botanical graphic.
items.rating_reason: Oatmeal is a Soft Autumn hero and a relaxed top balances hips. Black print is a bit stark but the base color and cozy homestead vibe make it a strong staple.

items.name: Oatmeal heather scoop tank
items.description: Muted heathered oatmeal/taupe tank with a ribbed modest scoop neck, wide straps, and a relaxed straight cut.
items.rating_reason: Warm oatmeal beats white or black as a Soft Autumn base. Tuck into jeans or a floral maxi for pear waist definition; year-round layer.

items.name: Sandy beige scoop tank
items.description: Light sandy beige sleeveless tank with a deeper scoop neck and medium-thin straps. Lightweight drapey jersey; a waffle cardigan is behind, not the focus.
items.rating_reason: Earthy beige is excellent Soft Autumn and a deeper scoop lifts the eye. Same job as the oatmeal tank—keep the better-condition one if they duplicate.

items.name: Ivory scoop-neck tank
items.description: Light cream/ivory deep-scoop tank with thin straps and a slightly textured lightweight knit. Photographed in front of a camel waffle cardigan.
items.rating_reason: Ivory is warmer than stark white so Soft Autumn can wear it, but thin straps and a pale scoop are less homestead-practical (sun, straps slipping). Good under the waffle cardigan.

items.name: Camel waffle-knit cardigan
items.description: Open-front long-sleeve cardigan in muted warm tan with a chunky waffle/honeycomb knit, wide ribbed trim, and two large patch pockets. Relaxed fit.
items.rating_reason: Camel is a Soft Autumn cornerstone, open front makes a vertical line and defines the waist over hips, pockets are mom-functional, and NW Arkansas shoulders need this most of the year. Hero layer.

items.name: GAP tan cream check flannel shirt
items.description: Long-sleeve GAP button-down in a large muted tan-and-cream check with a chest pocket; fabric looks brushed cotton or light flannel. Heavy wear with a large front hole, collar yellowing, and staining.
items.rating_reason: Colors are Soft Autumn gold, but the hole and stains make it unsuitable for a curated capsule—chore rag at best.

items.name: Dusty rose muscle tank
items.description: Sleeveless cotton jersey muscle tee in muted dusty rose with a ribbed crew neck and small left-chest patch pocket. Relaxed straight fit with wide armholes.
items.rating_reason: Muted warm pink is Soft Autumn friendly; wide shoulders help balance hips. Easy summer homestead layer when tucked.

items.name: Oatmeal These Are The Days hoodie
items.description: Light oatmeal fleece hoodie with white drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs/hem, and a white retro script graphic reading These Are The Days on the chest.
items.rating_reason: Warm neutral Soft Autumn staple and cozy for homestead days; boxy cut needs a tuck or layer for waist definition.

items.name: Olive ribbed V-neck sweater
items.description: Long-sleeve V-neck knit in muted olive with vertical ribbing through body and sleeves. Relaxed straight hem silhouette.
items.rating_reason: Signature Soft Autumn green plus a V-neck that lifts the eye; cozy layering hero for pear balance.

items.name: Marled oatmeal V-neck sweater
items.description: Relaxed long-sleeve V-neck in marled oatmeal/taupe knit with ribbed cuffs and hem. Medium-gauge textured, slightly rustic look.
items.rating_reason: Perfect Soft Autumn neutral with a flattering V; soft staple for layering over tees or under jackets.

items.name: Terracotta button-detail sweatshirt
items.description: Muted terracotta crew sweatshirt with diagonal shoulder-to-chest button plackets (three dark buttons each side), ribbed cuffs and hem. Slightly boxy relaxed fit.
items.rating_reason: Earthy Soft Autumn color and shoulder interest help balance hips; boxy cut still needs styling at the waist.

items.name: Black raglan crew sweatshirt
items.description: Solid black long-sleeve crew sweatshirt with raglan sleeves, ribbed crew neck, and thick ribbed hem. Classic boxy casual cut.
items.rating_reason: Practical for dirt and laundry but stark black clashes with Soft Autumn and adds no waist definition for pear.

items.name: Medium-wash denim trucker jacket
items.description: Classic trucker denim jacket in muted medium wash with collar, silver buttons, dual chest flap pockets, waist welt pockets, gold contrast stitching, and light jersey lining.
items.rating_reason: Muted wash works Soft Autumn; structured shoulders balance hips and denim is homestead durable.

items.name: Tomato red jersey maxi skirt
items.description: Solid warm red-orange knit maxi/midi skirt with a wide flat waistband and full gathered flare. Lightweight stretch jersey with soft drape.
items.rating_reason: Remove — color clashes with Soft Autumn capsule in real life; needs zipper repair. Not worth keeping in rotation.
items.notes: Removed Aug 2026: coloring doesn't fit wardrobe; zipper needs repair.

items.name: Burgundy crew-neck sweater
items.description: Deep burgundy/maroon long-sleeve crew sweater with fine knit texture and a horizontal seam across the upper chest. Simple ribbed crew neck.
items.rating_reason: Cozy practical staple, but deep cool burgundy is only a fair Soft Autumn match and the crew is neutrally pear.

items.name: Olive shorts with tan waistband
items.description: Muted olive woven shorts with a wide contrasting tan fold-over comfort/maternity-style elastic waistband, front slash pockets, and finished hems.
items.rating_reason: Core Soft Autumn olive/tan and post-baby comfort waist; practical summer homestead bottoms.

items.name: Red navy plaid cinched tunic
items.description: Long-sleeve button-down plaid tunic/short dress with collar, dual flap chest pockets, and an elastic cinched waist with slight peplum flare. Lightweight woven flannel-like fabric.
items.rating_reason: Cinched waist is excellent for pear and homestead-practical, but high-contrast bright red/navy is only fair Soft Autumn.

items.name: Charcoal gray striped scoop tank
items.description: Sleeveless scoop-neck tank in fine horizontal charcoal and heather-gray stripes with self-fabric binding at neck and armholes. Soft lightweight knit with some pilling.
items.rating_reason: Cool gray stripes sit outside Soft Autumn warmth; wearable basic only if needed.

items.name: Beige utility jacket with drawstring
items.description: Warm beige utility jacket with stand collar, metal snap front, large lower flap pockets, and an internal waist drawstring for cinching. Durable cotton-blend look.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn neutral with adjustable waist—ideal pear definition plus homestead-ready outer layer.

items.name: Black cream houndstooth pea coat
items.description: Mid-length double-breasted pea/overcoat in large black-and-cream houndstooth with wide notched lapels, large black buttons, structured shoulders, and black lining.
items.rating_reason: Shoulders and lapels balance pear beautifully and look polished, but high contrast is harsh for Soft Autumn and cream shows dirt.

items.name: White DENIZEN five-pocket shorts
items.description: DENIZEN from Levi's five-pocket cotton twill shorts in white/off-white. Same pair was photographed twice (also as IMG_0164).
items.rating_reason: Practical summer homestead short; light neutral works Soft Autumn as a soft white. One pair only — duplicate photo retired.
items.notes: Duplicate of IMG_0164 (same garment, second photo).

items.name: White DENIZEN shorts (duplicate photo)
items.description: Same pair as IMG_0163 — second photo only. Do not count as a separate piece.
items.rating_reason: Duplicate entry of IMG_0163 (white DENIZEN five-pocket shorts).
items.notes: Duplicate of IMG_0163. Use IMG_0163 in capsules/menus.

items.name: Oatmeal charcoal stripe pocket dress
items.description: Short-sleeve shallow V-neck midi dress in muted oatmeal and charcoal horizontal stripes with large front patch pockets. Relaxed straight linen/cotton-blend look.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn stripes and practical pockets win, but boxy cut plus hip-level pockets can widen pear without a belt.

items.name: Olive smocked Swiss-dot maxi dress
items.description: Muted olive maxi with smocked bodice, square neck, short flutter ruffle sleeves, and a tiered skirt with lace/crochet insets. Subtle Swiss-dot texture throughout.
items.rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn green; smocked waist and flowing tiers are textbook pear flattery with feminine homestead ease.

items.name: Dusty rose Joy Strength floral tee
items.description: Short-sleeve crew tee in muted dusty rose with a centered floral cluster graphic and vertical white text reading JOY and STRENGTH. Soft jersey casual fit.
items.rating_reason: Warm Soft Autumn base and soft florals feel joyful and wearable; tuck for pear waist definition.

items.name: Cognac faux-leather moto jacket
items.description: Waist-length cognac faux-leather moto with stand collar, front zip, quilted shoulder/upper-arm panels, multiple silver zip pockets, and snap cuffs.
items.rating_reason: Signature Soft Autumn cognac; cropped waist and shoulder quilting strongly balance pear while staying wipeable and polished.

items.name: Cognac knee-high riding boots
items.description: Tall knee-high riding-style boots in warm muted brown leather-look material with rounded toe, flat/low heel, and full inner zipper. Visible scuffing and wear at ankle and heel.
items.rating_reason: Soft Autumn color and tall shafts help balance hips for homestead wear, but heavy wear may need replacing soon. (Shoes, not clothing.)

items.name: Tan strappy sport sandals
items.description: Outdoor strappy sandals with muted tan woven straps, toe loop, adjustable black buckle at the ankle, and a thick dark contoured footbed. (Shoes; olive maxi hem also visible but not the focus.)
items.rating_reason: Earthy Soft Autumn straps and serious homestead practicality for NW Arkansas summers. (Shoes, not clothing.)

items.name: Black speckled marled sweater
items.description: Deep black crew-neck knit sweater with white/light-gray flecks throughout a marled speckled texture. Relaxed boxy silhouette with ribbed neck, cuffs, and hem.
items.rating_reason: Cozy and dirt-hiding, but base black is Soft Autumn poor; boxy fit skips pear waist definition.

items.name: White canvas slip-on sneakers
items.description: Low-profile white canvas laceless slip-ons with side elastic goring and flat white rubber soles. Visible scuffing and dirt from wear.
items.rating_reason: Handy slip-ons for busy mom life, but stark white clashes Soft Autumn and shows homestead dirt fast. (Shoes, not clothing.)

items.name: Thin brown belt
items.description: Thin brown/cognac belt purchased Aug 2026. Marks the high waist on jeans, olive pants, and boxy knits.
items.rating_reason: The missing waist tool. Soft Autumn brown; use on high-rise bottoms and t-shirt dresses. Photo 8/31: she already tucks — this finishes it.

items.name: Rust and black flannel
